greeting: Good morning, Rick! Grab your coffee, here's what's new in tech today.

items.title: Nvidia is reportedly preparing to fire Jensen Huang
items.note: Nvidia's board may meet as soon as today to decide whether to remove its longtime CEO after a scandal. Nvidia makes the chips behind most AI, and its stock fell sharply after hours.

items.title: Google brings the Gemini app to Apple CarPlay
items.note: You can now talk to Google's Gemini assistant hands-free on your car's screen. Just update the Gemini app on your iPhone and it shows up in CarPlay.

items.title: AirTag 2, AirPods and MacBook Air deals
items.note: Amazon's early Black Friday sale has a 4-pack of AirTag 2 for $70 and AirPods Pro 3 for $199. Some M5 MacBook Airs are $250 off too.

items.title: United won't let your AI agent book your flight
items.note: AI assistants can still look up United flights for you, but the airline is blocking them from buying tickets. You'll have to finish the purchase yourself.

items.title: Toyota's Scion is back with a 25-mph kei truck
items.note: The Scion name returns on a tiny Indiana-built work truck that follows the same low-speed rules as golf carts. A fleet pilot for farms and campuses starts in 2027.

items.title: Ring's camera drone won't have manual controls
items.note: Amazon's home security drone crashed twice during a CBS demo. When it ships in January, it will only fly preset routes around your house.

items.title: Apple's new holiday ad features the MacBook Neo
items.note: A short, sweet film about a kid who turns her drawings into a cartoon. Watch for a cameo from an old iPhone 3GS.
